player_prompt.intro: Kai ne Mai kunnawa {player_id} a cikin wasan Poker na Indiya. - Katin katin 52; kuna ganin katin abokin hamayyar ku kawai. - Ante {ante} kwakwalwan kwamfuta kowane zagaye, {max_rounds} zagaye 〔s) duka. - Ingantattun motsi: '[check] ' [bet X] ' [call] ' [raise X] [fold] ' (X lamba ce mai kyau <= adadin kwakwalwar ku.) - Mafi girman katin ɓoye ya lashe tukunyar a nunawa.

round.announce: ### Zagaye {current_round}/{max_rounds} Katin abokin adawar ku shine: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Supply exactly ONE bracketed action, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', or '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Ba za a iya ba [check] - kuna fuskantar fare.
invalid_move.amount_min: Dole ne adadin fare / ɗagawa ya zama ≥ 1.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: Ba za a iya [bet] - dole ne [call] / [raise] / [fold].
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Babu abin da za a kira; za ku iya [check] maimakon haka.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Yi amfani da [bet X] don buɗewa; babu fare don ɗagawa.
invalid_move.insufficient: Ba a samun isassun kwakwalwan kwamfuta don wannan aikin.

board.possible_actions: Abubuwan da za ku iya yi: {legal}

message.showdown_tie: Ƙungiyar nunawa: duka {card}. Rarraba tukunya  kowannensu ya karɓi {split}.
